headline: Nevish Line Erupts Anew as Kuura Strand Settles Under One Flag
war_summary: The lull on the Nevish Line is at an end. Where our last edition found that front strangely still, the hours since have brought forty-two flag movements, Princefal and Blackcoat Way the busiest points, and casualties running to hundreds each hour as this edition went to press. Kuura Strand, by contrast, has settled: Talven and Faden Point have ceased turning, and all six strongpoints there now stand in Colonial hands. The Weathered Expanse remains the war's furnace — forty-four movements in a day, Crow's Nest and Spirit Watch the busiest points of contention, the count standing at five Warden posts to one Colonial with three grounds ruined. Linn Mercy bears the day's heaviest toll, thousands fallen in twenty-four hours, with Outwich Ranch and Lathair the busiest points. Marban Hollow churns on at Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall; Stlican Shelf stirs at Briar; Mooring County, lately swept by the Wardens, has gone quiet, and Callahans Passage raises no flag though its casualty lists stay long. It is day 721; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is declared.
